- Spectrum: the marker now lands exactly where you tap, at any width (it used the centre and width of the first screen), and it goes when you move to a band where it is out of view. You can slide one finger along the spectrum to move it, and fine-tune it with − / + buttons (about 1 % of the width shown)
- Listen: the default tuning step in USB and LSB is now 500 Hz
- Bluetooth: the help text of the BLE spam detector was repeated, it is now one text
- Meshtastic: the transmit tab (the radio as a node) is removed, the tool only receives again
